pokedexEntries.sw: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

pokedexEntries.sh: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

pokedexEntries.sc: Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing, because it doesn’t have confidence in its brawn.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.
